title: WiX Toolset variables
description: Configuration variables for the cross-platform .NET 8 WiX v4/v5 and Windows WiX v3.14 Toolset.

WIX_VERSION.description: Specific version of the WiX Toolset to install (e.g., 'latest', '5.0.2', '4.0.5', or '3.14').

WIX_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install WIX ('libscript_native' via isolated dotnet tool / zip or 'system').

WIX_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Optional override URL for downloading WiX binary archive.

WIX_RELEASES_URL.description: Optional override URL for querying WiX release versions.
